title: Reachable-set and ball cardinalities
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $s,K$ be natural numbers. If $2^{	ext{code length}	imes(s+	ext{logarithmic space of }|x|+1)}le K$, where the code length is the machine's configuration-code bound, then the set of numbers in the $K$-bounded ball at level $K$, formed using the step relation at window radius $s$ and the corresponding initial-code predicate, has the same cardinality as the finite set of codes reachable from the initial configuration code within the stated code bound.
